title: NovaTech Devices — business laptops
content: NovaTech Devices supplies business laptops from Austin, United States. The NovaBook 14 has a 14-inch display, 32 GB RAM, 1 TB SSD and a three-year on-site warranty. The list price is USD 1,150 per unit. Orders of 20 or more receive a 5 percent volume discount, bringing the effective price to USD 1,092.50 per laptop. Standard lead time is 7 business days. NovaTech holds ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certifications, offers EPEAT Silver devices, and accepts net-30 payment. The minimum order quantity is 5 units. Customers rate NovaTech 4.7 out of 5 for reliability and support.

title: Orbit Systems — enterprise notebooks
content: Orbit Systems, based in Munich, Germany, sells the Orbit Pro 14 enterprise notebook. Configuration includes 32 GB RAM, 1 TB SSD, a three-year international warranty and a TPM 2.0 security module. The unit price is USD 1,275 with a minimum order of 10. Volume pricing at 25 units is USD 1,210 per unit. Delivery to the United States takes 12 business days. Orbit is ISO 27001 certified, its devices are ENERGY STAR qualified, and it provides a responsible disposal programme. The supplier rating is 4.8 out of 5. Orbit does not offer net-60 terms; payment is net-30.

title: BudgetByte — refurbished laptops
content: BudgetByte Refurbishing is located in Bengaluru, India and specialises in certified refurbished business laptops. The RefurbBook 14 costs USD 720 per unit with a one-year parts-and-labour warranty. Every device is data-wiped to NIST 800-88 and graded A or better. The minimum order is 10 units and the maximum is 50 units per order. Lead time is 15 business days to the United States. BudgetByte is ISO 14001 certified and reports a 62 percent lower embodied carbon footprint than a comparable new device, but it is not ISO 27001 certified. The supplier rating is 4.1 out of 5.

title: Clarity Displays — 27-inch monitors
content: Clarity Displays manufactures 27-inch QHD USB-C monitors in Taiwan. The Clarity 27Q costs USD 245 per monitor, has a three-year warranty, and includes a height-adjustable stand. Orders above 50 units receive free shipping. Lead time is 10 business days to the United States. The monitor is ENERGY STAR 8 certified and EPEAT Gold registered. Clarity accepts net-45 payment terms and has a supplier rating of 4.6 out of 5. The minimum order is 10 monitors.

title: CloudDesk Software — collaboration SaaS
content: CloudDesk Software provides a team collaboration platform priced at USD 120 per seat per year. The service is hosted in the United States and the European Union, is SOC 2 Type II certified and supports SAML single sign-on and audit logs. A data processing agreement and a 30-day termination-for-convenience clause are available. CloudDesk does not process payment card data. Implementation takes one business day and there is no minimum seat count. The supplier rating is 4.5 out of 5. Volume discounts begin at 250 seats.

title: OpenStack Services — platform support
content: OpenStack Services Ltd in the United Kingdom offers 24x7 support for self-managed open-source cloud platforms. The annual support contract is USD 18,000 and covers up to 250 nodes with a one-hour response target for severity-one incidents. The service is delivered remotely by staff with UK security clearance. OpenStack Services is ISO 27001 certified and has a supplier rating of 4.4 out of 5. The contract requires 30-day written notice and includes quarterly architecture reviews. No customer data leaves the customer's cloud environment.

title: ErgoWorks — height-adjustable desks
content: ErgoWorks manufactures height-adjustable standing desks in the United States. The ErgoLift desk costs USD 540 per desk, includes a five-year warranty, and is made with FSC-certified laminate. Orders above 25 desks receive a 7 percent discount. Lead time is 14 business days. The desks are BIFMA tested and have a 120 kg lifting capacity. ErgoWorks is a minority-owned business with a supplier rating of 4.5 out of 5. Delivery and installation are included within the continental United States.

title: GreenSeat — ergonomic office chairs
content: GreenSeat is a Polish manufacturer of ergonomic task chairs. The GreenSeat Pro costs USD 310 per chair and includes a three-year warranty and a 98 percent recyclable frame. The minimum order is 20 chairs and delivery to the United States takes 18 business days. GreenSeat is GREENGUARD Gold certified and its fabrics contain no added flame retardants. The supplier rating is 4.2 out of 5. Assembly is required and instructions are included. GreenSeat accepts net-30 payment and does not provide installation services.

title: SecurePrint — endpoint security suite
content: SecurePrint provides an endpoint security suite with device encryption, mobile device management and phishing simulation. The annual licence for up to 500 endpoints is USD 15,000. SecurePrint is SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certified, supports data residency in the United States and the EU, and signs a data processing agreement. The platform does not require access to customer content. Onboarding takes three business days. The supplier rating is 4.6 out of 5 and the contract can be terminated for convenience with 60 days' notice.

title: SafeGuard Supplies — workshop PPE
content: SafeGuard Supplies sells workshop personal protective equipment from Ohio, United States. Nitrile gloves are USD 8 per box of 100, safety glasses are USD 6 per pair, and high-visibility vests are USD 14 each. Orders above USD 2,000 receive a 10 percent discount. Lead time is 5 business days. All products meet ANSI Z87.1 or EN 388 requirements. SafeGuard is ISO 9001 certified, has a supplier rating of 4.3 out of 5, and accepts net-30 payment. The minimum order is USD 100.

title: PocketPro — managed smartphones
content: PocketPro, headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, supplies managed smartphones for field teams. The PocketPro X costs USD 820 per device with a two-year warranty and includes a mobile device management enrolment licence. Bulk orders of 30 or more receive a 4 percent discount. Lead time is 9 business days. Devices support Android Enterprise zero-touch enrolment and receive five years of security updates. PocketPro is ISO 27001 certified and has a supplier rating of 4.4 out of 5. Payment terms are net-30.

title: SkyStack Cloud — committed cloud credits
content: SkyStack Cloud offers a committed-use cloud credit package of USD 50,000 per year for compute, object storage and managed PostgreSQL. Unused credits expire after 12 months. The platform is SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certified and provides a data processing agreement. SkyStack supports a 99.95 percent monthly availability target and offers 24x7 support. There is no implementation lead time because the account is provisioned in one business day. The supplier rating is 4.7 out of 5. A 5 percent discount applies to a two-year commitment.

title: POL-001 Purchase approval thresholds
content: All purchases require a documented business need and a named budget owner. Purchases with a total value up to USD 10,000 may be approved by the department head. Purchases above USD 10,000 and up to USD 50,000 require approval from the Chief Financial Officer (CFO). Purchases above USD 50,000 and up to USD 100,000 require a competitive tender and CFO approval. Purchases above USD 100,000 additionally require board approval. The total value includes taxes, shipping, implementation and the full committed contract term. Approval authority may not be delegated to the requester. Emergency purchases follow POL-008 but never bypass budget checks.

title: POL-002 Budget availability and no split purchases
content: A purchase may proceed only when the cost centre has sufficient uncommitted budget. The available budget equals the approved annual budget minus committed and spent amounts. Requesters must not split a purchase into smaller orders to avoid an approval threshold or a competitive tender. If the requested amount exceeds the available budget, the request must be rejected or deferred until additional budget is approved. Multi-year contracts reserve the full contract value in the first year unless the CFO approves an alternative accounting treatment. Budget owners must reconcile commitments monthly.

title: POL-003 Supplier selection and fair competition
content: Suppliers must be evaluated on total cost of ownership, quality, delivery risk, security posture and sustainability, not price alone. Purchases above USD 10,000 require at least three written quotes unless a documented sole-source exception is approved by procurement. Purchases above USD 50,000 require a formal competitive tender. Preferred suppliers may be used when they meet the requirement and their pricing is within 10 percent of the best compliant quote. A supplier must not be selected solely because of a personal relationship. All supplier evaluations and exceptions must be retained for audit.

title: POL-004 Software security and data protection
content: Software and cloud services that store, process or transmit company data require a current SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 certification, single sign-on support and a signed data processing agreement. Suppliers must declare data residency and subprocessors. Services handling personal data require a privacy impact assessment before purchase. End-of-life software and unsupported operating systems must not be purchased. Security review is required for any new SaaS tool regardless of contract value. A 30-day termination-for-convenience clause is preferred but not mandatory for low-risk tools.

title: POL-005 Competitive tenders above USD 50,000
content: Any purchase or contract with a total value above USD 50,000 requires a competitive tender unless the CFO grants a written sole-source exception. The tender must be open for at least 10 business days, include a published evaluation matrix, and receive at least three compliant bids. A cross-functional panel of procurement, finance and the business owner evaluates bids separately before consensus scoring. The panel must document why the winning bid provides the best value. The CFO and the business owner approve the award. Tender records are retained for seven years.

title: POL-006 Sustainable electronics purchasing
content: Electronic equipment should meet ENERGY STAR or EPEAT Silver (or better) where available. Requesters must consider remanufactured or refurbished devices when the use case permits, provided the supplier offers a warranty of at least one year and certified data sanitisation. Suppliers should disclose packaging reduction and take-back options. Sustainability is a scored criterion in tenders above USD 50,000 but must not override mandatory security requirements. Devices that fail the security baseline cannot be purchased even if they have strong environmental credentials. Asset disposal must follow the IT asset disposition procedure.

title: POL-007 Conflicts of interest and gifts
content: Employees involved in procurement must disclose any financial interest, family relationship or outside employment connected to a supplier. A conflicted employee must recuse themselves from evaluation and approval. Gifts, hospitality or meals with a value above USD 100 per occasion must be declined or declared to compliance. Supplier-sponsored travel is prohibited unless approved in writing by the ethics officer. Repeated small gifts must be aggregated when assessing the threshold. Declarations are retained by compliance and are not shared with the supplier. Undisclosed conflicts may result in disciplinary action and contract termination.

title: POL-008 Emergency procurement
content: Emergency procurement is limited to situations that threaten safety, critical service continuity or information security. The requester must document the emergency, the failure to plan, and the scope of the purchase. The CFO or delegate must approve the emergency in writing within 48 hours. A retroactive competitive process is required within 10 business days if the value exceeds USD 10,000. Emergency status never removes the requirement for a budget check, conflict-of-interest disclosure or security review. Standing emergency purchases with a single supplier require annual renewal and are reported to the audit committee.
